notes.title: Let there be light!
notes.content:
What will be your lighting of your choice in "Follia - Dear Father"?

[b]Lighter[/b] - weak but steady, unless you run.
[b]Flashlight[/b] - strong beam, reliable even when running, but drains batteries quickly.
[b]Camera flash[/b] - really lights up the place, but just for a second at a time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35065076/d675fffebf8529d61d6ca995c200a5f43dc839c6.png[/img]

notes.title: Follia Dear Father - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Please check out "Follia - Dear Father"! A survival horror from another talented Italian indie team we started working with. 
If you prefer gore and blood than this one's for you!
Let's not forget about our hero Marcus, who is drawn into the horrors that have emerged on the university campus where his parents work.
We will publish the game in fall on PC, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, and it will also feature a VR version for HTC Vive and PlayStation VR.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EqiRf1TK9PQ
